findings.message: User task "Assess claim" is a job-worker user task; Camunda 8.6 deprecates those in favour of Camunda user tasks.
findings.suggestion: Add zeebe:userTask to make it a Camunda user task.

findings.message: User task "Assess claim" has no zeebe:formDefinition.
findings.suggestion: Link a form (formId), an external form, or an embedded form.

findings.message: Service task "Check for fraud" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:taskDefinition.
Sub-process "Review items" is multi-instance without a zeebe:loopCharacteristics.
findings.suggestion: Set the input collection to iterate over.

findings.message: Script task "Price item" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:script or zeebe:taskDefinition.
Service task "Pay out claim" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:taskDefinition.
Message end event "Claim paid" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:taskDefinition.
